description: This file defines interfaces for shared memory buffer management within the Rialto media server component, including factory creation, buffer mapping/unmapping, data access, and metadata retrieval.

classes.name: ISharedMemoryBuffer
classes.description: Interface for managing shared memory buffers used for media playback, including mapping, unmapping, data access, and metadata retrieval.

classes.name: ISharedMemoryBufferFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating shared memory buffer instances.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to an ISharedMemoryBufferFactory instance.
